messages:
sophie: FYI Acme reported a sudden spike of 503s on our hosted embeddings route (/v1/embeddings) starting ~11:22 UTC. They send large batched requests (~100 items) and see 503s + streaming timeouts. They say SDK retries are causing duplicate billing. Posting their curl and the error snippets they sent.

sophie: customer snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -d '{"input": ["...", "...", "..."], "model":"embed-xl"}' \n```

sophie: error (from customer):
```
HTTP/2 503 \ncontent-type: application/json
request-id: 7f8a3b2c
{ "error": { "message": "upstream_error: 503 Service Unavailable" }}
```

rahul: thanks. do we have a request-id or x-edge id from them? also are they using our official sdk + which version?

sophie: they pasted request-id above (7f8a3b2c). using our node SDK v1.3.1 (not latest). batch size ~100 per call. they said they saw the gateway return 503 and then sdk retried automatically which led to repeated charges.

carlos: pulling logs for request-id 7f8a3b2c — hang on. infra-bot: alert/ingress/503-spike at 2026-03-16T11:21:00Z (matched).

devon: quick thought — large batches + older SDK + token rotation fanout can cause connection stalls at the edge proxy. If the proxy queue backs up, it can return 503 quickly. do we have edge queue depth metrics for that window?

carlos: metrics show a short-lived ingress queue spike across us-west-2 edge pool 11:20–11:25 UTC (p95 queue depth up ~6x). also saw increased kvcache write latencies for embed shard folks.

emily: billing note — if their SDK retried and they were charged multiple times we'll want to credit duplicates. can we confirm the number of successful token consumptions per original request id?

jen: assigning this to SRE to triage root cause. preliminary repro idea: 1) large batch => long processing time, 2) client retries on 5xx, 3) proxy rejects queued requests during brief overload. temporary mitigations: advise reduce batch size, disable aggressive client retries, upgrade SDK.

sophie: shared a short repro script they used (node):
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-xl', input: new Array(100).fill('hello') });
```

devon: can reproduce locally-ish by firing parallel batched embed calls with batch=80 and keepalive disabled on client sockets. see: client config suggestions below.

devon: temporary SDK/workaround to suggest to customer:
- set batchSize: 20
- set maxRetries: 1 (or 0)
- if using streaming, try non-streaming path for embeddings
- upgrade to SDK v1.4.2 (fixes connection pooling for large batches)

sophie: passing those mitigation steps to customer now. they can confirm if reducing batch solves it immediately.

rahul: infra note — we should also throttle large multi-tenant batches at the edge so one noisy tenant doesn't blow qdepth. filing infra ticket.

carlos: dug deeper: edge proxy had a bug where long-running backend responses plus a simultaneous token-refresh fanout caused a priority inversion in the connection multiplexer; connections were being held in the accept queue leading to early 503s from the upstream LB. patch candidate created, rolling deploy planned in 2h.

emily: billing — create a credit for Acme for any duplicate invoice lines between 11:20–11:30 UTC. I'll handle after SRE confirms counts.

jen: action items:
- devon to validate patch in staging (in 30m)
- carlos to schedule rolling deploy (2h rollout window)
- support (sophie) to confirm customer mitigation and pause retries client-side
- billing (emily) to prepare credits list

infra-bot: incident-4892 created (edge-priority-inversion), severity: P2, links: https://internal.redwood/incident/4892

sophie: customer update: they reduced batch to 20 and saw successful responses for 10 test calls. asked for ETA on fix.

rahul: thumbs up. once patch is live we'll notify and recommend SDK upgrade. also check for any other tenants showing similar patterns.

devon: verified patch reduces queue hold in staging (stress run with concurrent batch=100 across 200 clients) — latency and 5xx rates back to baseline. prepping prod deploy notes.

carlos: rolling deploy started (+ canary 5% now). monitoring p95 queue depth and 5xx rate.

jen: follow-up: root cause summary for postmortem: edge connection multiplexer + token refresh fanout + large batches => transient accept-queue saturation => upstream 503s and client-side retries => duplicate billing. mitigation: server patch to prioritize accept queue fairness, SDK v1.4.2 with improved connection pooling, docs: recommended batch sizes and retry defaults.

emily: billing done — created pro-rated credits for Acme for the impacted window, will send details to support for customer comms.

carlos: deploy finished, 5%->100% over 20m. observed 5xx rate dropped back to normal.

sophie: updated customer thread with fix timeline and credits. they said appreciate the quick turnaround and will upgrade SDK per our recommendation. closing loop once they confirm no recurrence tomorrow. :pray:

jen: mark for postmortem and add to rollout checklist to include edge multiplexer test on large-batch workload.

sophie: closing note to internal thread: we should add an SDK warning when batchSize>50 in older SDKs to recommend upgrade. logged RFC: https://go.redwood/devex/rfc/sdk-batch-warnings

sophie: thanks team, great cross-org response.
